Drugs that induce SIADH (Syndrome of Inappropriate Antidiuretic Hormone Secretion) or NSAIDs (Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs) increase the risk of water retention and electrolyte imbalances when used with bowel preparation solutions.
